name: Neo4jEnterpriseCluster
description: Declaratively manages a Neo4j Enterprise causal cluster (minimum 2 servers) built as a single {name}-server StatefulSet whose pods self-organize into primary/secondary roles via serverModeConstraint, with V2 discovery, cert-manager TLS, plugin installation, backup/restore integration, optional Aura Fleet Management, optional MCP server, live cluster diagnostics, and an optional self-hosted TCP proxy exposing the cluster for network-mode cross-cluster database replication (CCDR).

fields.name: name
fields.note: metadata.name of the Neo4jEnterpriseCluster custom resource

fields.name: image.repo
fields.note: Enterprise image repository (invariant: neo4j:5.26-enterprise / neo4j:2025.01.0-enterprise, never community)

fields.name: topology.servers
fields.note: Number of Neo4j servers in the {name}-server StatefulSet; min 2, operator-imposed cap 100

fields.name: topology.serverModeConstraint
fields.note: NONE|PRIMARY|SECONDARY — global mode hint for all servers; per-server override via topology.serverRoles

fields.name: storage.size
fields.note: Size of the data PVC per server pod

fields.name: acceptLicenseAgreement
fields.note: yes|eval — explicit acceptance of the Neo4j Enterprise commercial or 30-day evaluation license; operator refuses to deploy until set

fields.name: tls.mode
fields.note: cert-manager|disabled

fields.name: tls.issuerRef.name
fields.note: Name of a cert-manager ClusterIssuer (or compatible external issuer); ClusterIssuer is not modeled as an entity here

fields.name: tls.strictPeerValidation
fields.note: Default true; controls intra-cluster mTLS trust_all/client_auth/verify_hostname posture

fields.name: auth.adminSecret
fields.note: Name of a Kubernetes Secret (keys: username, password) holding initial admin credentials; Secret is not modeled here

fields.name: monitoring.enabled
fields.note: Default true; enables Prometheus metrics, query logging, and live diagnostics collection

fields.name: audit.enabled
fields.note: Opts into compliance-oriented defaults (e.g. query-literal obfuscation) for PCI/HIPAA/GDPR

fields.name: networkPolicy.enabled
fields.note: Default false; emits a NetworkPolicy restricting ingress, notably closing backup port 6362 to non-operator pods

fields.name: mcp.enabled
fields.note: Default false; deploys the official mcp/neo4j MCP server for this cluster

fields.name: mcp.transport
fields.note: http|stdio; default http. In stdio mode the operator injects NEO4J_URI + credentials; in http mode credentials come per-request from the client

fields.name: propertySharding.enabled
fields.note: Enables property sharding support (Infinigraph) on Neo4j 2025.12+ clusters

fields.name: auraFleetManagement.enabled
fields.note: Installs the pre-bundled fleet-management plugin and registers the deployment with Neo4j Aura Fleet Management

fields.name: auraFleetManagement.tokenSecretRef.name
fields.note: Name of a Kubernetes Secret containing the Aura Fleet Management registration token; Secret is not modeled here

fields.name: upgradeStrategy.strategy
fields.note: RollingUpgrade|Recreate; default RollingUpgrade

fields.name: status.phase
fields.note: Current phase of the cluster as observed by the controller

fields.name: status.ready
fields.note: Whether the cluster is ready for connections

fields.name: status.version
fields.note: Current observed Neo4j version running in the cluster

fields.name: crossClusterReplication.enabled
fields.note: Default false. Deploys a self-hosted TCP proxy (HAProxy) exposing this cluster's tx-shipping port (6000) via one LoadBalancer Service, for a downstream Neo4jReplicaDatabase using source.mode: network. RAFT (7000) and routing (7688) stay internal-only.

fields.name: tls.additionalClusterTrustCAs
fields.note: Peer clusters' CA certificates, each projected into /ssl/trusted/ alongside this cluster's own CA — required for mutual TLS when replicating across clusters with different CAs. Must be set on both clusters.

fields.name: status.crossClusterReplication.ready
fields.note: True once the CCDR proxy's LoadBalancer Service has an assigned hostname/IP and every server's advertised address routes through it.

fields.name: status.crossClusterReplication.addresses
fields.note: Ready-to-paste host:port list for a downstream Neo4jReplicaDatabase's source.addresses, one entry per server ordinal.

fields.name: status.internalAddresses
fields.note: Always-populated "<pod-fqdn>:6000" list for a downstream Neo4jReplicaDatabase on this SAME Kubernetes cluster (source.upstreamClusterRef reads this directly). No proxy or LoadBalancer needed, unlike status.crossClusterReplication.addresses; not routable from a genuinely separate Kubernetes cluster.

fields.name: spec.networkPolicy.allowReplicasFrom
fields.note: Opt-in list of {name, namespace} downstream Neo4jEnterpriseClusters admitted as a NetworkPolicy peer on port 6000 only (never RAFT/routing) — fixes same-Kubernetes-cluster network-mode CCDR being blocked by the base peer-restriction rule. Nothing admitted unless listed; purely declarative, no controller change.

name: Neo4jEnterpriseStandalone
description: Declaratively manages a single-node Neo4j Enterprise deployment for development, testing, and low-availability production workloads, built on the same clustering infrastructure as Neo4jEnterpriseCluster but with replicas=1, remaining compatible with the rest of the CRD ecosystem (Neo4jDatabase, Neo4jPlugin, Neo4jBackup, etc.).

fields.name: name
fields.note: metadata.name of the Neo4jEnterpriseStandalone custom resource

fields.name: image.repo
fields.note: Enterprise image repository (invariant: neo4j:5.26-enterprise / neo4j:2025.01.0-enterprise, never community)

fields.name: storage.size
fields.note: Size of the data PVC for the single Neo4j pod

fields.name: acceptLicenseAgreement
fields.note: yes|eval — explicit acceptance of the Neo4j Enterprise commercial or 30-day evaluation license

fields.name: tls.mode
fields.note: cert-manager|disabled

fields.name: tls.issuerRef.name
fields.note: Name of a cert-manager ClusterIssuer (or compatible external issuer); ClusterIssuer is not modeled as an entity here

fields.name: auth.adminSecret
fields.note: Name of a Kubernetes Secret (keys: username, password) holding initial admin credentials; also required for NEO4J_AUTH / Neo4jDatabase support. Secret is not modeled here

fields.name: monitoring.enabled
fields.note: Default true; enables Prometheus metrics, query logging, and live diagnostics collection

fields.name: audit.enabled
fields.note: Shares AuditSpec with Neo4jEnterpriseCluster; compliance-oriented log tuning

fields.name: networkPolicy.enabled
fields.note: Default false; restricts ingress to the standalone pod, notably closing backup port 6362

fields.name: mcp.enabled
fields.note: Default false; deploys the official mcp/neo4j MCP server for this standalone deployment

fields.name: mcp.transport
fields.note: http|stdio; default http

fields.name: auraFleetManagement.enabled
fields.note: Installs the pre-bundled fleet-management plugin and registers this standalone with Neo4j Aura Fleet Management

fields.name: upgradeStrategy.strategy
fields.note: RollingUpgrade|Recreate; default RollingUpgrade

fields.name: trustedCASecrets
fields.note: List of {name,key} Secret references imported into the JVM truststore for outgoing TLS (OIDC, LDAPS, Aura Fleet Management, plugin mirrors); Secrets not modeled here

fields.name: status.phase
fields.note: Current phase of the standalone deployment

fields.name: status.version
fields.note: Current observed Neo4j version

fields.name: status.databaseStatus.databaseMode
fields.note: Expected to read "SINGLE" for a standalone deployment

name: Neo4jPlugin
description: Declaratively installs and manages a Neo4j plugin (APOC, Graph Data Science, Bloom, GenAI, n10s, GraphQL, or a custom plugin) on a referenced cluster or standalone by merging it into the target StatefulSet's NEO4J_PLUGINS env var (or, for installMode VerifiedDownload, a checksum-verified init container) and triggering a controlled rolling restart.

fields.name: name
fields.note: metadata.name of the Neo4jPlugin custom resource

fields.name: clusterRef
fields.note: Name of the target Neo4jEnterpriseCluster or Neo4jEnterpriseStandalone in the same namespace; ambiguous which Kind, so refEntityId left unset (could be ent-neo4jenterprisecluster or ent-neo4jenterprisestandalone)

fields.name: name
fields.note: spec.name — the plugin identifier (e.g. "apoc", "graph-data-science"), distinct from the CR's own metadata.name

fields.name: enabled
fields.note: Default true

fields.name: installMode
fields.note: Managed|PreBaked|VerifiedDownload; default Managed. VerifiedDownload injects a checksum-verifying init container instead of using NEO4J_PLUGINS

fields.name: source.type
fields.note: official|community|custom|url; default official

fields.name: source.url
fields.note: Required (https only) when installMode=VerifiedDownload or source.type=url/custom

fields.name: source.checksum
fields.note: sha256:<64 hex> or sha512:<128 hex>; required when installMode=VerifiedDownload

fields.name: source.authSecret
fields.note: Name of a Kubernetes Secret with credentials for a private plugin repository/mirror; Secret not modeled here

fields.name: config
fields.note: map[string]string of plugin-specific configuration entries

fields.name: dependencies
fields.note: List of {name, versionConstraint, optional} plugin dependencies; unsupported when installMode=VerifiedDownload

fields.name: security.allowedProcedures
fields.note: Procedure allowlist entries applied to dbms.security.procedures.unrestricted-style config

name: Neo4jDatabase
description: Neo4jDatabase declaratively manages a single named Neo4j database inside a referenced cluster or standalone, issuing CREATE / ALTER / DROP DATABASE statements against the system database.

fields.name: clusterRef
fields.note: References a Neo4jEnterpriseCluster or Neo4jEnterpriseStandalone (same namespace) whose DBMS hosts this database; ambiguous target kind, resolved at runtime.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Required database name issued in CREATE/ALTER/DROP DATABASE statements.

fields.name: options
fields.note: Database creation options map.

fields.name: initialData.source
fields.note: One of cypher; dump; csv.

fields.name: wait
fields.note: Defaults true; wait for database creation to complete.

fields.name: ifNotExists
fields.note: Defaults true; create database only if it doesn't exist.

fields.name: topology.primaries
fields.note: Primaries for this database; primaries+secondaries <= cluster.spec.topology.servers.

fields.name: defaultCypherLanguage
fields.note: "5" or "25"; Neo4j 2025.x only.

fields.name: seedURI
fields.note: URI (s3/gs/azb/http/ftp) of an existing backup/dump to seed the database from.

fields.name: seedConfig.restoreUntil
fields.note: RFC3339 timestamp or txId:N for point-in-time recovery (2025.x only).

fields.name: seedCredentials.secretRef
fields.note: Secret with seed-URI credentials when system-wide cloud auth is unavailable.

fields.name: status.state
fields.note: online, offline, started, stopped.

fields.name: status.servers
fields.note: Cluster servers currently hosting this database.

name: Neo4jDatabaseAlias
description: Neo4jDatabaseAliasSpec defines a local database alias — a second name for an existing database in the same DBMS, used to give a cross-cluster-replication replica a stable client-facing name across promotion.

fields.name: clusterRef
fields.note: The Neo4jEnterpriseCluster or Neo4jEnterpriseStandalone (same namespace) that hosts both the alias and its target.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Alias name in Neo4j; defaults to metadata.name when empty.

fields.name: targetDatabase
fields.note: Name of the database (standard or a cross-cluster replica) this alias points at; not a Kubernetes object reference, and need not already exist.

fields.name: deletionPolicy
fields.note: Delete (default, DROP ALIAS) or Retain.

fields.name: status.conditions
fields.note: Ready, ClusterNotReady.

fields.name: status.phase
fields.note: Pending, Ready, Failed.

fields.name: status.observedTarget
fields.note: Read back from SHOW ALIASES FOR DATABASE; differs from spec.targetDatabase only between an out-of-band change and the next reconcile.

name: Neo4jShardedDatabase
description: Neo4jShardedDatabase declaratively manages a property-sharded Neo4j database (Neo4j 2025.12+ feature), coordinating the graph shard and N property shards each with its own topology.

fields.name: clusterRef
fields.note: Reference to the Neo4j cluster (or standalone) that will host this sharded database.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Name of the sharded database to create.

fields.name: defaultCypherLanguage
fields.note: Required; "25" only — property sharding requires Cypher 25 syntax.

fields.name: propertySharding.propertyShards
fields.note: Number of property shards to create (1-1000).

fields.name: propertySharding.propertyShardTopology.replicas
fields.note: Replicas per property shard; same topology applied to all property shards.

fields.name: ifNotExists
fields.note: Pointer type so explicit false survives round-trips; mutually exclusive with replaceExisting:true.

fields.name: replaceExisting
fields.note: Destructive: DROP DATABASE ... DESTROY DATA WAIT then recreate from seedBackupRef. Requires force:true.

fields.name: force
fields.note: Separate confirmation field required alongside replaceExisting.

fields.name: seedURI
fields.note: Single seed URI; backup artifacts expected under shard-suffixed names.

fields.name: seedBackupRef
fields.note: Names a Neo4jBackup CR whose most-recent Succeeded run seeds this sharded database; resolved into a concrete seedURI at reconcile time. Cloud-storage-backed backups only.

fields.name: seedURIs
fields.note: Seed URIs keyed by shard name.

fields.name: txLogEnrichment
fields.note: e.g. FULL.

fields.name: status.lastBackup.backupRef
fields.note: Reverse-lookup pointer populated when a Neo4jBackup of kind=ShardedDatabase targeting this CR succeeds.

fields.name: status.lastDestructiveRestoreGeneration
fields.note: Generation at which the last successful destructive restore ran; prevents re-triggering DROP on every reconcile.

name: Neo4jReplicaDatabase
description: Neo4jReplicaDatabaseSpec defines a read-only cross-cluster replica of a database hosted on another Neo4j cluster, applied to the downstream cluster and fed either by an object-storage differential-backup chain (source.mode: backup) or by streaming directly from the upstream's cluster endpoints (source.mode: network, which requires the upstream to have spec.crossClusterReplication enabled).

fields.name: clusterRef
fields.note: The downstream Neo4jEnterpriseCluster or Neo4jEnterpriseStandalone (same namespace) that will host the replica.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Replica database name; defaults to metadata.name; permanent (no RENAME DATABASE), survives promotion.

fields.name: upstreamDatabase
fields.note: Name of the database being replicated as known on the upstream cluster; becomes replicaConfig.remote. Not a Kubernetes object reference — the upstream cluster is not visible to this operator.

fields.name: topology.primaries
fields.note: Both primaries and secondaries are read-only for a replica.

fields.name: source.mode
fields.note: backup (default; pulls a differential chain, no network path needed) or network (streams directly from source.addresses; requires the upstream cluster's spec.crossClusterReplication.enabled: true).

fields.name: source.pullURI
fields.note: Object-storage directory holding the upstream's differential backup chain; must be the directory the upstream Neo4jBackup CR writes into (its status.replicationPullURI) — a cross-cluster string URI, not an in-namespace object reference. Becomes replicaConfig.pullURI. Mutually exclusive with source.upstreamBackupRef.

fields.name: source.seedURI
fields.note: Full backup artifact the replica is initially seeded from, from the same chain as pullURI.

fields.name: source.addresses
fields.note: Network mode only: upstream cluster endpoints (host:port). One reachable address is sufficient — the upstream hands back the addresses the downstream actually uses. Mutually exclusive with source.upstreamClusterRef. Ignored in backup mode.

fields.name: source.credentialsSecretRef
fields.note: Secret with object-storage credentials for pullURI/seedURI.

fields.name: pullInterval
fields.note: Maps to Neo4j's db.cluster.backup.pull_interval, default 1m; bounds the replica's RPO.

fields.name: deletionPolicy
fields.note: Delete (default) or Retain; never drops once promoted, regardless of setting.

fields.name: status.phase
fields.note: Pending, Seeding, Replicating, Promoted (terminal), Failed.

fields.name: status.databaseType
fields.note: Live `type` column from SHOW DATABASES; the operator's authoritative signal over status.phase.

fields.name: status.replicationLag
fields.note: Transactions behind upstream; the data loss a promotion right now would make permanent.

fields.name: status.promotedBy
fields.note: Names the Neo4jReplicaPromotion CR that promoted it, or the sentinel string "out-of-band".

fields.name: source.upstreamClusterRef
fields.note: {name, namespace} reference to an upstream Neo4jEnterpriseCluster on this SAME Kubernetes cluster; the controller resolves addresses automatically from its status.internalAddresses. Mutually exclusive with source.addresses. Cannot reach a genuinely separate Kubernetes cluster (resolution is a live Get against this cluster's own API server).

fields.name: source.upstreamBackupRef
fields.note: {name, namespace} reference to an upstream Neo4jBackup CR on this SAME Kubernetes cluster; the controller resolves source.pullURI automatically from its status.replicationPullURI. Mutually exclusive with source.pullURI. Cannot reach a genuinely separate Kubernetes cluster (live Get against this cluster's own API server).

name: Neo4jReplicaPromotion
description: Neo4jReplicaPromotionSpec requests the one-way, irreversible promotion of a cross-cluster replica into an ordinary read-write database, deliberately modeled as a one-shot CR rather than a mutable field.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Kubernetes object name (metadata.name) — this one-shot CR has no separate spec.name field.

fields.name: replicaRef
fields.note: The Neo4jReplicaDatabase CR (same namespace) to promote; immutable via CEL rule.

fields.name: topology.primaries
fields.note: Optional topology change applied via dbms.promoteReplicaDatabase; immutable; omitted retains the replica's existing topology.

fields.name: status.phase
fields.note: Pending, Promoting, Completed (terminal), Failed (terminal).

fields.name: status.observedLagTxIds
fields.note: Replica's replicationLag immediately before promotion — the RPO recorded (never enforced) for audit.

name: Neo4jBackup
description: Neo4jBackup declaratively manages a Neo4j backup: the operator runs `neo4j-admin database backup` against the referenced cluster or standalone target, writes the artifact to local PVC or a supported cloud bucket (S3/GCS/Azure/MinIO), records the outcome on status, and optionally enforces retention or chains differentials off another Neo4jBackup CR.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Kubernetes object name (metadata.name); identifies this backup CR.

fields.name: instanceRef
fields.note: Names the Neo4jEnterpriseCluster or Neo4jEnterpriseStandalone (in this namespace) to back up; operator resolves cluster vs standalone itself. Preferred over the legacy target block as of v1.13.

fields.name: database
fields.note: Single-database scope; mutually exclusive with allDatabases and shardedDatabase.

fields.name: allDatabases
fields.note: Instance-wide scope: backs up every user database (system DB excluded).

fields.name: shardedDatabase
fields.note: Name of the Neo4jShardedDatabase CR to back up as a unit (graph shard + all property shards in one neo4j-admin run).

fields.name: storage.type
fields.note: StorageLocation.Type enum: s3;gcs;azure;pvc.

fields.name: schedule
fields.note: Cron expression for automated backups.

fields.name: mode
fields.note: standard (default) or replication-source; replication-source enforces single-database scope, unbroken diff chain, and publishes status.replicationPullURI.

fields.name: retention.deletePolicy
fields.note: Only "Delete" supported (Archive removed in v1.14, never had archival logic).

fields.name: options.backupType
fields.note: FULL;DIFF;AUTO, default AUTO.

fields.name: options.compress
fields.note: Pointer type; default true. Use CompressEffective(), never dereference directly.

fields.name: suspend
fields.note: Suspends the backup schedule.

fields.name: chainFromBackup
fields.note: Names another Neo4jBackup CR in the same namespace whose shared directory this CR writes into instead of its own, for mixed-cadence FULL/DIFF chains.

fields.name: status.replicationPullURI
fields.note: Exact object-storage directory a downstream cross-cluster replica should pull from; populated only when spec.mode=replication-source.

name: Neo4jRestore
description: Neo4jRestore declaratively restores a Neo4j database from a previously-completed Neo4jBackup or a direct storage location, driving point-in-time recovery (PITR) via source.type=pitr / source.pointInTime, and runs a neo4j-admin restore Job (standalone) or a cluster Cypher recreateDatabase/seedURI path against the referenced target.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Kubernetes object name (metadata.name).

fields.name: instanceRef
fields.note: Names the Neo4jEnterpriseCluster or Neo4jEnterpriseStandalone to restore INTO; the operator picks the restore engine from the target's topology.

fields.name: source.type
fields.note: backup;storage;pitr.

fields.name: source.backupRef
fields.note: Reference to a Neo4jBackup CR (when source.type=backup); resolved once into status.resolvedSource so the restore survives the backup CR's deletion.

fields.name: source.storage.type
fields.note: Direct StorageLocation (when source.type=storage): s3;gcs;azure;pvc.

fields.name: source.backupPath
fields.note: Specific backup path within storage.

fields.name: source.pointInTime
fields.note: Point-in-time target for restore (type=pitr, or PITR on top of a backup/storage source).

fields.name: database
fields.note: Mutually exclusive with allDatabases.

fields.name: allDatabases
fields.note: Restores every user database recorded in the source backup; requires source.type=backup; per-database progress tracked in status.databaseResults.

fields.name: options.additionalArgs
fields.note: Additional neo4j-admin restore arguments (string array).

fields.name: stopCluster
fields.note: Stop cluster before restore (required for some restore operations).

fields.name: timeout
fields.note: Go duration bounding the cluster Cypher restore's online-convergence wait; default 5m.

fields.name: status.databaseResults
fields.note: Per-database phase/message/completionTime for an allDatabases restore.

fields.name: status.resolvedSource.artifactFilename
fields.note: Exact .backup filename resolved from source.type=backup; required by cluster Cypher restore paths (cloud seedURI / PVC proxy).

name: Neo4jUser
description: Neo4jUser maps 1:1 to a user in the referenced Neo4j cluster's `system` database, reconciling identity, password (via a Secret reference, never a raw password field), account status, home database, and role-name bindings on every loop — privileges are never managed here, only on Neo4jRole.

fields.name: name
fields.note: spec.username, defaulting to metadata.name; the Neo4j username.

fields.name: clusterRef
fields.note: Name of the Neo4jEnterpriseCluster or Neo4jEnterpriseStandalone whose security graph owns this user. Not applicable to Aura (console-RBAC only).

fields.name: passwordSecretRef
fields.note: Reference (name+key) to a Kubernetes Secret holding the native-auth password; the CR never stores the plaintext password. Required unless externalAuth is set. The referenced Secret's value is SHA-256-hashed only for change detection, never for authentication.

fields.name: requirePasswordChange
fields.note: Maps to Neo4j's SET PASSWORD CHANGE REQUIRED.

fields.name: accountStatus
fields.note: active (default) or suspended.

fields.name: roles
fields.note: List of Neo4jRole names (built-in or custom) to grant; privileges are never set here, only on Neo4jRole. PUBLIC is implicit and never revoked.

fields.name: externalAuth.provider
fields.note: Non-native auth provider name (e.g. oidc-okta, ldap1, saml1), maps to SET AUTH '<provider>' { SET ID '...' }.

fields.name: externalAuth.id
fields.note: User's identifier within the external provider (e.g. OIDC sub claim or LDAP DN).

fields.name: deletionPolicy
fields.note: Delete (default, DROP USER) or Retain.

fields.name: status.currentRoles
fields.note: Role names actually granted, observed via SHOW USERS YIELD roles.

fields.name: status.passwordSecretHash
fields.note: Change-detection token derived from the Secret's namespace/name/key/resourceVersion — deliberately NOT sha256(password) (a prior unsalted-hash-of-password design was removed as a credential-recovery risk); never used in any auth path.

name: Neo4jRole
description: Neo4jRole maps 1:1 to a role in the referenced Neo4j cluster's `system` database; the controller diffs spec.privileges against `SHOW ROLE <r> PRIVILEGES AS COMMANDS` and applies the difference declaratively, with built-in roles (PUBLIC, reader, editor, publisher, architect, admin) manageable only when adoptBuiltin is true and never dropped on CR delete.

fields.name: name
fields.note: spec.name, defaulting to metadata.name; the Neo4j role name.

fields.name: clusterRef
fields.note: Name of the Neo4jEnterpriseCluster or Neo4jEnterpriseStandalone whose security graph owns this role. Not applicable to Aura.

fields.name: copyOf
fields.note: Existing role to seed privileges from at creation time only; ignored thereafter.

fields.name: privileges
fields.note: Desired set of complete GRANT/DENY Cypher statements ending 'TO <role-name>'. Privileges live ONLY on Neo4jRole, never on Neo4jUser or Neo4jRoleBinding. REVOKEs are derived textually by the controller, not user-supplied.

fields.name: enforcePrivileges
fields.note: Default true: controller reverts manual privilege drift. False: applies only at creation, never revokes out-of-band grants.

fields.name: adoptBuiltin
fields.note: Required to manage a built-in role name; such roles are never dropped on CR delete.

fields.name: deletionPolicy
fields.note: Delete (default, DROP ROLE) or Retain.

fields.name: status.appliedPrivileges
fields.note: Canonicalised privilege statements last observed via SHOW ROLE PRIVILEGES AS COMMANDS.

fields.name: status.privilegeDrift
fields.note: True when live privileges differ from spec at end of reconcile (e.g. immutable privileges that cannot be removed).

name: Neo4jRoleBinding
description: Neo4jRoleBinding declares a desired set of Neo4j role grants for a username the operator does not manage as a Neo4jUser — typically an SSO/LDAP/OIDC-provisioned user — keeping that user's role grants in sync with spec.roles without creating or dropping the user itself; the validator rejects overlap with a Neo4jUser managing the same username.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Kubernetes object name (metadata.name); the CR has no separate spec.name field.

fields.name: clusterRef
fields.note: Name of the Neo4jEnterpriseCluster or Neo4jEnterpriseStandalone whose security graph owns the user. Not applicable to Aura.

fields.name: username
fields.note: Neo4j username to manage role grants for; must already exist in Neo4j (created externally, e.g. SSO first-login provisioning).

fields.name: roles
fields.note: List of Neo4jRole names to grant (built-ins accepted directly; custom names must exist, typically via Neo4jRole CRs). Only role names live here — no privileges. PUBLIC is implicit, never granted/revoked.

fields.name: enforceExclusive
fields.note: Default false. True makes spec.roles authoritative for the user's full role set, REVOKEing out-of-band grants on every reconcile.

fields.name: deletionPolicy
fields.note: Revoke (default) or Retain.

fields.name: status.grantedRoles
fields.note: Subset of spec.roles successfully granted, observed via SHOW USERS YIELD roles.

fields.name: status.conditions
fields.note: Includes Ready, RolesSynced, UserNotFound, PendingDependencies, ClusterNotReady.

name: Neo4jAuthRule
description: Neo4jAuthRule defines a Neo4j attribute-based access control (ABAC) AUTH RULE that conditionally grants one or more roles when its Cypher condition — referencing OIDC-token claims via abac.oidc.user_attribute('claim_key') — evaluates true at authentication time; available only on Neo4j 2026.03+ clusters, and granted roles must never carry DENY privileges.

fields.name: name
fields.note: spec.name, defaulting to metadata.name; identifier shown in SHOW AUTH RULES.

fields.name: clusterRef
fields.note: Name of the Neo4jEnterpriseCluster or Neo4jEnterpriseStandalone whose security graph owns this rule; must be Neo4j 2026.03+.

fields.name: condition
fields.note: Cypher expression evaluated against the user's OIDC token at auth time (e.g. abac.oidc.user_attribute('department') = 'sales'); this is the claims-to-roles mapping logic. Must be a pure expression — no DDL.

fields.name: enabled
fields.note: Default true. Disabled rules are preserved in Neo4j but affect no session.

fields.name: grantedRoles
fields.note: Neo4j roles granted when condition evaluates true. Must exist (directly or as Neo4jRole CRs) and MUST NOT contain DENY privileges.

fields.name: enforceRoles
fields.note: Default true: revokes out-of-band roles not in grantedRoles. False: only adds, never revokes.

fields.name: deletionPolicy
fields.note: Drop (default, DROP AUTH RULE) or Retain.

fields.name: status.phase
fields.note: Pending, Ready, Failed, or PendingDependencies.

fields.name: status.appliedRoles
fields.note: Roles last observed as granted via SHOW AUTH RULES.

name: AuraProviderConfig
description: Holds Neo4j Aura API OAuth client credentials and account-level defaults (default project ID, default organization ID for v2beta1 resources, and an overridable base URL), and is referenced by AuraInstance and other Aura resources via spec.providerConfigRef, with the controller owning one shared token cache and Aura API rate limiter (25/125 req/min) per config.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Kubernetes object name identifying this provider config.

fields.name: spec.credentialsSecretRef.name
fields.note: Secret (same namespace) holding the Aura OAuth client credentials.

fields.name: spec.defaultOrganizationId
fields.note: Used by v2beta1 resources (e.g. AuraIPFilter) that reference this config without their own organizationId.

fields.name: spec.baseUrl
fields.note: Overrides the Aura API base URL; intended for testing against a fake API server.

fields.name: status.conditions
fields.note: Ready=True once an access token was successfully obtained with the referenced credentials.

name: AuraInstance
description: Declaratively manages a Neo4j Aura cloud instance via the Aura REST API — provision, resize, pause/resume, and optionally delete — using the Aura API v1 for the whole lifecycle except that setting spec.multiDatabase routes the CREATE call through the v2beta1 API instead, which accepts a narrower set of fields and silently ignores the rest.

fields.name: name
fields.note: spec.name, the Aura instance display name; defaults to metadata.name.

fields.name: spec.providerConfigRef
fields.note: Selects the AuraProviderConfig providing credentials, defaults, and the shared token cache/rate limiter.

fields.name: spec.organizationId
fields.note: Only needed for the v2beta1 code paths (multiDatabase creation and the multi-database status probe).

fields.name: spec.cloudProvider
fields.note: aws;gcp;azure. Immutable.

fields.name: spec.region
fields.note: Immutable.

fields.name: spec.type
fields.note: free-db;professional-db;business-critical;enterprise-db;professional-ds;enterprise-ds. Immutable except professional-db -> business-critical.

fields.name: spec.version
fields.note: Coarse Aura Neo4j major version (e.g. "5"). Immutable.

fields.name: spec.storage
fields.note: Not configurable for type=free-db.

fields.name: spec.paused
fields.note: Desired paused state, drives pause/resume.

fields.name: spec.multiDatabase
fields.note: Immutable; only kind of instance AuraDatabase/AuraDatabaseBackup/AuraDatabaseRestore can target; switches the CREATE call to the v2beta1 API.

fields.name: spec.customerManagedKeyId
fields.note: Value-based link (not a K8s name ref) to the Aura-assigned key ID published in AuraCustomerManagedKey.status.customerManagedKeyId; immutable once set; enterprise-db/enterprise-ds only.

fields.name: spec.source.instanceRef
fields.note: Clones a new instance from another AuraInstance (same namespace) at create time; immutable.

fields.name: spec.instanceId
fields.note: Adopts/imports an existing Aura instance by ID rather than creating one; immutable once set.

fields.name: spec.deletionPolicy
fields.note: Orphan (default) or Delete.

fields.name: status.phase
fields.note: Creating, Running, Pausing, Paused, Resuming, Updating, Restoring, Destroying, ...

fields.name: status.connectionUrl
fields.note: Bolt routing URL (neo4j+s://...).

fields.name: status.atProvider.multiDatabase
fields.note: Unset means UNKNOWN, not false; probed once from the v2beta1 instance detail (unavailable for v1-created instances) and cached.

name: AuraSnapshot
description: Takes an on-demand snapshot of an AuraInstance (the Aura equivalent of Neo4jBackup); because the Aura API cannot delete snapshots, deleting this CR only releases its finalizer and drops it from cluster state — the Aura snapshot itself persists.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Kubernetes object name (this CRD has no spec.name field).

fields.name: spec.instanceRef
fields.note: AuraInstance (same namespace) being snapshotted; immutable.

fields.name: status.profile
fields.note: AdHoc or Scheduled.

fields.name: status.phase
fields.note: Pending, InProgress, Completed, Failed.

fields.name: status.exportable
fields.note: Whether the snapshot can seed a new instance.

name: AuraRestore
description: Restores an AuraInstance in place from one of its snapshots (the Aura equivalent of Neo4jRestore) as a one-shot action recorded as an auditable object: on completion the CR stays as history and does not re-fire.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Kubernetes object name (this CRD has no spec.name field).

fields.name: spec.instanceRef
fields.note: Target AuraInstance (same namespace) restored in place; immutable.

fields.name: spec.snapshotId
fields.note: Mutually exclusive with spec.snapshotRef; immutable.

fields.name: spec.snapshotRef
fields.note: Resolves the snapshot ID from an AuraSnapshot CR in the same namespace; mutually exclusive with spec.snapshotId; immutable.

fields.name: status.phase
fields.note: Pending, Restoring, Completed, Failed.

fields.name: status.snapshotId
fields.note: Snapshot actually restored (resolved from snapshotRef when used).

name: AuraCustomerManagedKey
description: Registers a customer-managed encryption key (CMK) with Aura for use by dedicated-tier AuraInstances (enterprise-db / enterprise-ds only); the key material lives in the customer's own cloud KMS and Aura stores only a reference to it, with every placement field (cloud provider, region, instance type, KMS key) permanently immutable once set. UNPROVEN — never exercised against the live Aura API.

fields.name: name
fields.note: spec.name, the CMK's display name in Aura; defaults to metadata.name.

fields.name: spec.projectId
fields.note: Immutable once set.

fields.name: spec.cloudProvider
fields.note: aws;gcp;azure. Immutable.

fields.name: spec.region
fields.note: Immutable.

fields.name: spec.instanceType
fields.note: enterprise-db;enterprise-ds. Immutable.

fields.name: spec.keyId
fields.note: AWS KMS key ARN / GCP KMS key resource name / Azure Key Vault key URL; the customer must grant Aura access out of band; immutable.

fields.name: spec.deletionPolicy
fields.note: Orphan (default) or Delete (deregister — fails while any instance still uses it).

fields.name: status.customerManagedKeyId
fields.note: Aura-assigned key ID; referenced from an AuraInstance's spec.customerManagedKeyId.

fields.name: status.phase
fields.note: Pending, Ready, Deleting, Error.

name: AuraIPFilter
description: Manages a Neo4j Aura network IP filter (allowlist) via the Aura API v2beta1, an unstable BETA endpoint; IP filters are ORGANIZATION-scoped in the API, but this CRD models the common case of applying one to a set of AuraInstances.

fields.name: name
fields.note: spec.name, the filter's display name in Aura; defaults to metadata.name.

fields.name: spec.organizationId
fields.note: Filters are org-scoped in v2beta1.

fields.name: spec.allowList
fields.note: Array of {address, prefixLen, description} CIDR entries; at least one required, max 1000.

fields.name: spec.instanceRefs
fields.note: AuraInstances (same namespace) the filter applies to; resolved to Aura instance IDs (filtered_entities.instances).

fields.name: spec.filteringDisabled
fields.note: Turns the filter off without deleting it.

fields.name: spec.deletionPolicy
fields.note: Orphan (default) or Delete.

fields.name: status.phase
fields.note: Pending, Ready, Error.

name: AuraDatabase
description: Manages a database on a managed Neo4j Aura instance via the Aura API v2beta1 (BETA / best-effort — v2beta1 is an unstable beta and the database create body is not fully schema'd upstream); Aura manages replication/topology per tier itself, so unlike the self-managed Neo4jDatabase CRD this one has no topology knob.

fields.name: name
fields.note: spec.name, the database name in Aura; defaults to metadata.name.

fields.name: spec.instanceRef
fields.note: Hosts the database; must be an AuraInstance created with spec.multiDatabase=true.

fields.name: spec.organizationId
fields.note: Overrides the organization resolved from the instance's AuraProviderConfig.

fields.name: spec.deletionPolicy
fields.note: Delete (default) or Orphan.

fields.name: spec.managementPolicies
fields.note: List of Observe;Create;Update;Delete;* restricting operator actions.

fields.name: status.phase
fields.note: Pending, Ready, Error.

name: AuraDatabaseBackup
description: Takes an on-demand per-database backup of a database on a managed Neo4j Aura instance via the Aura API v2beta1 (BETA / best-effort); per-database backups exist only on multi-database tiers.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Kubernetes object name (this CRD has no spec.name field).

fields.name: spec.databaseRef
fields.note: Database backed up; credentials, organization, project and instance are resolved from it.

fields.name: spec.managementPolicies
fields.note: Observe;Create;Delete;*.

fields.name: status.backupId
fields.note: Mirrored into the neo4j.com/external-backup-id annotation so the backup is taken once.

fields.name: status.phase
fields.note: Pending, Completed, Error.

fields.name: status.timestamp
fields.note: Raw string Aura reports for the backup's timestamp; not parsed.

fields.name: status.exportable
fields.note: Whether Aura can export/download this backup; populated only once read back.

name: AuraDatabaseRestore
description: Restores a database on a managed Neo4j Aura instance from one of its per-database backups via the Aura API v2beta1 (BETA / best-effort), one-shot and in place; it is never reported Completed because Aura restores asynchronously and the v2beta1 database endpoint exposes no restore status, so the terminal success phase is Submitted.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Kubernetes object name (this CRD has no spec.name field).

fields.name: spec.databaseRef
fields.note: Database restored in place.

fields.name: spec.backupId
fields.note: Mutually exclusive with spec.backupRef.

fields.name: spec.backupRef
fields.note: Resolves the backup ID from an AuraDatabaseBackup CR in the same namespace; mutually exclusive with spec.backupId.

fields.name: spec.managementPolicies
fields.note: Observe;Create;*.

fields.name: status.phase
fields.note: Restoring, Submitting, Submitted (terminal success), or Error — never Completed; a CR found in Submitting is not retried since repeating a restore overwrites the database again.

name: AuraOrganizationMember
description: Manages the organization-level role of an existing Aura console user (identified by email) via the Aura API v2beta1 (BETA / best-effort); this is Aura PLATFORM identity (console/org access), not an in-database Neo4j user, and bringing in a brand-new person instead requires an AuraInvite.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Kubernetes object name (this CRD has no spec.name field; identity is spec.email).

fields.name: spec.email
fields.note: Identifies the existing org member whose role is managed.

fields.name: spec.role
fields.note: organization-owner;organization-admin;organization-member (Aura's own v2beta1 organization_roles values).

fields.name: spec.deletionPolicy
fields.note: Orphan (default) or Delete (remove them from the organization).

fields.name: status.userId
fields.note: Aura user ID resolved from the email.

fields.name: status.phase
fields.note: Pending, Ready, NotAMember, Error.

name: AuraProjectMember
description: Manages the project-level role of an existing Aura console user (identified by email) via the Aura API v2beta1 (BETA / best-effort); this is Aura PLATFORM identity (project access), not an in-database Neo4j user, and a wholly unknown email still needs an AuraInvite.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Kubernetes object name (this CRD has no spec.name field; identity is spec.email).

fields.name: spec.email
fields.note: Identifies the existing project member whose role is managed.

fields.name: spec.role
fields.note: project-admin;project-member;project-viewer;project-metrics-integration-reader; the invite API spells the same concepts namespace-* (see AuraInvite.spec.role).

fields.name: spec.deletionPolicy
fields.note: Orphan (default) or Delete (remove them from the project).

fields.name: status.userId
fields.note: Aura user ID resolved from the email.

fields.name: status.phase
fields.note: Pending, Ready, NotAMember, Error.

name: AuraInvite
description: Invites an email address to a Neo4j Aura organization, or to a project within it, with a role via the Aura API v2beta1 (BETA / best-effort); this is how a new person is granted Aura console access, while an existing member's role is instead managed with AuraOrganizationMember / AuraProjectMember.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Kubernetes object name (this CRD has no spec.name field; identity is spec.email).

fields.name: spec.projectId
fields.note: Scopes the invite to a project (a namespace-* role); omit for an organization-level invite.

fields.name: spec.role
fields.note: organization-owner;organization-admin;organization-member;namespace-admin;namespace-member;namespace-viewer;namespace-metrics-integration-reader.

fields.name: spec.organizationRole
fields.note: organization-owner;organization-admin;organization-member. Required alongside a namespace-* role — Aura requires an organization role on every invite, an empty roles list is rejected outright; verified live 2026-08-01.

fields.name: spec.deletionPolicy
fields.note: Delete (default; revoke a still-pending invite) or Orphan.

fields.name: status.phase
fields.note: Pending, Sent, Accepted, Error.
